svg.title: ICMPv4 Echo request: header, then body
svg.desc: The ICMPv4 Echo request of frame 1 of icmp_echo.pcapng, 32 bits per row: type 8, code 0, checksum 0x145c, then the Echo body with identifier 0x0500, sequence 0x3400 and 32 bytes of pattern data; IcmpPacket keeps the common header as fields and the body as IcmpBody::Echo, and the transport payload stays None so nothing is probed above it.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
